## File: facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/tasks/light_genderation_bias/agents.py

Prompts

```
['run the LightGenderTeacher to load and serve LIGHT dialogue data with gender bias mitigation', 'create counterfactual examples by flipping gendered pronouns like he to she in dialogue text', 'review the get_bucket method to classify text into gender bins based on male and female word counts', 'test the get_finegrained_count function to count female, male, and neutral gendered words in text', 'refactor the read_gender_tsv function to load a TSV of gendered word lists into a dictionary', 'run the build function to download and set up the light_genderation_bias dataset', 'review the build function to understand how it downloads and marks data as built', 'summarize the build function logic for downloading and versioning the genderation bias dataset', 'test the build function to verify it downloads the genderation_bias.tgz file correctly', 'refactor the build function to support additional downloadable resources for the dataset']
```

```

```
